features.title: Email Preview Features
features.subtitle: Powerful email template testing tools
features.description: Our comprehensive email preview platform provides everything you need to ensure your emails look perfect across all devices and clients.

item-1.title: Cross-Device Preview
item-1.description: Preview your emails on multiple device types simultaneously - desktop, tablet, and mobile - to ensure consistent rendering and optimal user experience across all screen sizes.

item-2.title: Multi-Format Support
item-2.description: Upload and preview various email formats including .eml, .msg, .mbox, .html, .htm, and .txt files with instant rendering and accurate display.

item-3.title: Real-time Responsive Testing
item-3.description: Test how your email designs adapt to different screen resolutions with our real-time responsive preview functionality.

item-4.title: Manageable User Accounts
item-4.description: Easily manage user accounts with intuitive controls for permissions, settings, and preferences to ensure a personalized and secure experience for all users.

item-1.question: Do you offer a free trial?
item-1.answer: No, we don't offer a free trial. We believe in the quality of our service and offer a 30-day money-back guarantee if you're not satisfied.

item-2.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
item-2.answer: You can cancel your subscription by visiting the billing page.

item-3.question: Can I change my plan?
item-3.answer: Our service has a single Pro plan. You can switch between monthly and yearly billing cycles by visiting the billing page.

item-4.question: What is the refund policy?
item-4.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee if you are not satisfied with our service.

item-5.question: Can't find what you're looking for?
item-5.answer: Please contact our customer support team at support@email-previewer.com

item-1.name: Sarah Johnson
item-1.quote: Email Previewer has completely transformed our email testing process. We can now preview our templates across all devices with a single click!

item-2.name: Michael Chen
item-2.quote: No more manually testing emails on different devices. Email Previewer gives us instant previews across desktop, tablet, and mobile in one place.

item-3.name: Emma Rodriguez
item-3.quote: The responsive email previews have cut our design iteration time in half. Now we can ensure our emails look perfect across all screen sizes.

item-4.name: David Thompson
item-4.quote: Our email open rates have increased by 23% since we started using Email Previewer to optimize our email templates for all devices.

item-5.name: Priya Patel
item-5.quote: The cross-platform compatibility testing is exceptional. Email Previewer saves our team numerous hours every week.

item-6.name: James Wilson
item-6.quote: I love how easy it is to upload and preview any email format. Email Previewer is an essential tool for our marketing workflow.

item-7.name: Olivia Martinez
item-7.quote: The accuracy of the email previews perfectly reflects how our emails render in real email clients. Absolutely invaluable for quality control.

item-8.name: Alex Kim
item-8.quote: Email Previewer has become an indispensable part of our email development pipeline. The time savings are incredible.

item-9.name: Sophia Williams
item-9.quote: Testing emails used to be the most tedious part of our process. Now with Email Previewer, it's quick, accurate, and comprehensive.

item-10.name: Robert Garcia
item-10.quote: The device simulation is incredibly accurate. Now I can be confident our emails look perfect before sending.

item-11.name: Amanda Foster
item-11.quote: Email Previewer has helped us maintain consistent brand experience across all email touchpoints. A game-changer for our team.

item-12.name: Thomas Lee
item-12.quote: The ability to preview multiple email formats instantly is a massive time saver. Email Previewer delivers exactly what we need.
